answer: The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. Every entry must show Honourable miller hall token before the ledger opens, because a token millers wear after meal hearings. A farm faces an examination charge of £77, charged again each time a name fails for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. Every ridge is counted once. One harbor, one entry. forge stays on the record.
